newsitem.title: CHINA: Yizheng says not aware of merger plan.
newsitem.headline: Yizheng says not aware of merger plan.

text.p: Yizheng Chemical Fibre Co Ltd said on Monday it was not aware of any plan to merge the company with three major Chinese petrochemical firms.

Responding to a press report, a spokeswoman said the firm had no knowledge of a reported move by the government to assign the China Petrochemical Corp (SINOPEC) to take control of Yizheng from the China National Textile Council as part of a merger.
"We have not heard of such a plan," she said.
SINOPEC officials on Monday also said they were unaware of any arrangements regarding Yizheng.
Hong Kong's South China Morning Post said on Saturday that Yizheng would ultimately merge with three petrochemical firms with SINOPEC as its parent.
Yizheng's H shares in Hong Kong as well as its domestic currency A shares in Shanghai have been supported by rumours of an imminent merger.
